plan.title: Split Lots Disabled on Closed RFQ

steps.note: Enable lot creation for the tenant as required by the case.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Work on the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Apply an available RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item so the RFQ can be published and closed.
Commit a bidding schedule required for publication.
Add a QA vendor so the RFQ is usable and can receive a bid.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Create a buyer-side bid so the closed RFQ has bid activity without requiring another login.
Close the published RFQ before inspecting its Settings menu.
Assert that the lots action is present but disabled on the closed RFQ.
